name: Agency hero: a scrubbable twenty-one day build log in which two of the nine entries are failures, marked and unsoftened
notes: Signature effect: the visitor drags through a real build day by day. It does not play at them, it answers them. The content is the risky part and the reason it works: two entries are failures (day 9, images shipped at 4MB; day 18, the contact form sent empty submissions), they are marked in amber, they are not at the end, and they are not softened. The control is a real <input type="range">, which brings keyboard control, touch dragging and a correct screen reader announcement for free; nothing hand-rolled would get all three right. Ticks are positioned by actual day number over 21, not by index, so the calendar gaps are true. The WebKit track has no native progress element, hence the --pct custom property painting the fill. One nudge animation fires once on first sight so the control reads as draggable without a tooltip. Uses the amber #E8B84B proposed as the brand's fifth colour (9.15:1 on charcoal); its light-mode companion would need to be far darker at #7A5E10, since amber on sand is only 1.64:1. Part of the ten hero 940Digital brand series (sections 0027 to 0036); the series log, the contact sheet that renders all ten live, and the written recommendation are in brand-heroes/set-evidence/. Unlike the client-derived sections in this library, this one is NOT de-identified: 940Digital is Owen's own business, so there is no third party to protect and the real wordmark, palette and copy are the point of the section. Brand rules baked in across the whole series: display type at weight 500 with about -0.03em tracking (not 700); #3194E0 never carries text on a light background because it measures 2.90:1, so blue text on sand is #1F6FB0 and a blue fill takes a charcoal label at 5.18:1; every figure is JetBrains Mono with tabular-nums; text containers are sized in ch, not px.
